49817.synopsis:

*

Lan Ge is the most outstanding prodigy from the Blue Domain. He lives in the Blue Domain, advocates freedom, lives as a free soul, is an expert at battling, and controls the power of the Elements.

Whenever they were attacked by other non-human tribes, they would work together to fight against their common enemy. Given these huge conflicts between their Domains, it was only by chance of a risky adventure that Fa Hua and Lan Ge crossed paths. Through a serendipitous encounter, they were both bound together by a mysterious contract that allowed them to share the same fate. 66457.synopsis:
In the eyes of the public, Lu Jingshen is the epitome of the second generation: highly educated, refined, respectful to elders, and loving towards his siblings. He has no vices, diligently taking over the family business, dedicating himself to the company and the family.
Only those close to him know that he is actually rigid, serious, and devoid of fun. He holds extremely high standards for others and even higher standards for himself, making him a workaholic.

When they meet again, Lu Jingshen was still as proud, aloof, and unattainable as before. But behind the facade, the gaze fixed on him was still filled with longing.
Though the game is the same, Feng Si has no intention of playing it a second time.
*Feng Si x Lu Jingshen

67225.synopsis:
Two Planet is a moderately recognized small-medium idol group. As the leader and main vocalist, Hee-Wook thought things would get better. Even after the team’s most popular visual member left and the hiatus period extended due to COVID-19, he consoled himself that everything would turn out well.
However, the reality he faced after his military discharge was the disbandment of his team and unemployment. Hee-Wook, desperate to hang on to anything, attends a drama audition where he encounters top star Cheon Kyung-Seo.
“You were an idol, weren’t you? Your expressions and speech become rigid when things get tough. Is that what it is?”
“Regardless of my profession, I naturally have a cold face, and my way of speaking is curt.”
“I wish you would smile a bit…”
“…But I’ll still act well according to the character. Please look favorably upon me, senior.”
Cheon Kyung-Seo’s first impression, with his rude tone and attitude, was quite terrible. However, Hee-Wook finds himself having to align with Kyung-Seo after being cast in a friend role. Despite the initial impression, Hee-Wook is desperate to make the most of this barely obtained opportunity.
On the other hand, there’s top star Cheon Kyung-Seo, who debuted as a child actor and just turned adult this year. His days feel like a roller coaster ride. Why? Because he gets to star in a drama with his all-time favorite idol, Hee-Wook!
Kyung-Seo wishes to be of help to Hee-Wook, but it’s not easy. Disappointed with himself for continually faltering in front of his favorite idol, Kyung-Seo keeps lingering around Hee-Wook…

67993.synopsis:
Mei Fang’s rebirth story takes him back 20 years to the year 2002, becoming a 6-year-old boy who just wet the bed during nap time.

From a well-behaved little angel to a mischievous little devil.

The personalities of these playmates who spend their days together will evolve with the changing circumstances. Do you still like the way she was at the beginning?

After countless years, the evolved insectoid race no longer required a queen to control them. And Michele was left to experience first love alone, something no one had taught him—not his brothers in the South, nor the “Ain” in the North…

124313.synopsis:
Qin Miaoyan is the Rogue Cultivator Sovereign of Nether Valley.  
During a rescue mission for her disciples, she was stunned to find a young cultivator who bore an uncanny resemblance—80% alike—to her long-dead lover.  
At her level of cultivation and status, there was no reason to suppress her desires. So, she employed some methods to bring him under her wing, shaping him like a tree—pruning and molding him to match the image of her former lover.  
Don’t laugh. When you smile, you stop resembling him.  
Don’t speak. The moment you open your mouth, you stop resembling him.  
Don’t wear black. He never wore black.  
Just when she had nearly perfected him and was enjoying the fruits of her labor, she made a shocking discovery—this young cultivator was actually the son of her former lover!  
Qin Miaoyan was both stunned and furious, as she had once believed her lover died saving her. Turns out, it was all a lie!  
Before she could even react, the usually obedient young man came at her with a sword.  
Eyes bloodshot and expression fierce, he snarled: “You lied to me! You said I resembled your deceased brother—that’s why I agreed to follow your every whim. But it was all because you couldn’t have my father!”  
The supposedly dead former lover, now resurrected: “You… How have you become so deranged? H-he’s my son!”  
Qin Miaoyan: “…Let me explain.”  
Screw explanations.  
Yes, I did it. So what?  
Qin Miaoyan sneered: “Want to break up? Not so easy. Either come back with me, or I’ll chop your father into pieces and feed him to the fish. Your choice.”  
——  
Later, according to insiders from Nether Valley, the Supreme Sovereign created a clone and spent over three months secretly coaxing her little cultivation partner back.

127897.synopsis:
Fake-weak but secretly cunning Consort × Pretty-but-dangerously-black-bellied Princess
Song Jinsheng transmigrated.
She woke up in a dynasty that doesn’t exist in any history books.
On her very first day here, she was already married off—to none other than the most favored princess of the realm, Princess Wei Luoyi.
To make things worse, she wasn’t just anyone: she had inherited the identity of a fallen noble’s orphan, someone who had gotten close to the princess for the sake of revenge.
The system told her there were only two ways to return to her original world:
Divorce the princess.
Complete the original owner’s revenge.
Song Jinsheng didn’t even hesitate. Divorce, obviously.
So, at her very first meeting with the princess, she said with great sincerity:
 “Your Highness, let’s pick a date and get divorced.”
Wei Luoyi: “???”
******************
Wei Luoyi was naturally suspicious by nature. The more Song Jinsheng wanted to run, the less she intended to let her go.
She asked for divorce? Then divorce was the one thing she would never get.
Left with no choice, Song Jinsheng tried everything to provoke the princess by bringing “little sisters” home, chasing “big sisters” outside—just to make herself unbearable.
Surely that would do it.
But who would’ve thought… not only was the princess completely unfazed, she even did the unthinkable: inviting Song Jinsheng into her palace chambers, lighting the lamps, and making her share a bed.
Late at night, lying side by side, Song Jinsheng stared at the princess’s serene sleeping face and muttered bitterly:
 “Your Highness… do you really not mind?”
The princess opened her eyes lazily, her gaze cool but amused.
 “Has my consort’s head gone soft, and taken her temperament with it?”
“Or have you forgotten—you’re a woman?”
Song Jinsheng froze, then quickly snapped back, retorting stubbornly:
 “Who says women can’t like women?!”
“There’s plenty two women can do together!”
“Oh?” Wei Luoyi’s lips curved faintly, eyes dark with something unreadable. She said nothing more.
【System notification: Wei Luoyi’s favorability +10】
Song Jinsheng: “What?!!”
She was trying to get divorced!
 So why did it feel like things were going… very, very wrong?
